text:
mia: Planning a staggered rollout for ff `smart_route_v2` tonight 01:00 UTC. Ramp: 0.25% -> 1% -> 4% with 10m holds. We'll pin `route_version=2.0.3` for cohorts.
nate: Sounds good. Who's owning the first hold?
mia: @nate you have first watch, @oliver second. I'll coordinate rollback if needed.
deploy-bot: Scheduled. I'll post 2m cadence updates. Commands: 
```
ffctl set smart_route_v2 --cohort=0.25% --param route_version=2.0.3
monctl watch --metrics p95,errors,request_fidelity --window=10m
```
oliver: Add preflight: block progression if eval-drop > 1% or request_fidelity < 98%.
mia: Agreed. Also enable `kv_prefill=true` for pinned cohort.
deploy-bot: 0.25% enabled. Warmup in progress.
deploy-bot: (5m) p95 210ms baseline 200ms, errors 0.04%, eval-drop 0.2% — proceeding to 1%.
nate: Proceed. Watching traces.
deploy-bot: 1% enabled. Holding.
deploy-bot: (hold) eval-drop 1.4% at 1% cohort. Holding progression and alerting owners.
mia: Hold. Do not progress. Nate, can you collect a couple failing traces and tag them in #release-rollback?
nate: On it, posting traces now.
oliver: Suggest reduce cohort to 0.5% and run targeted hotfix for token mapping. Partial rollback avoids full revert.
mia: Good idea. @deploy-bot reduce to 0.5% and keep kv_prefill.
deploy-bot: Cohort reduced to 0.5%. Flag remains enabled for pinned cohort. Posting summary to #release-logs.
mia: I'll open a hotfix PR for tokenizer alignment, schedule a re-run tomorrow morning. Thanks team.
